text:
The primary material of a candle is wax.

In the context of the cyberpunk metropolis described, this simple organic substance stands in stark contrast to the high-tech environment. While the city above is defined by synthetic neon, hovercars, and digital surveillance, the candle represents a return to basic, pre-industrial elements. The wax, typically derived from tallow, beeswax, or paraffin, serves as the fuel source that, when melted by a wick, produces a small, flickering flame. This light is not the omnipresent, electric glow of the digital billboards, but a warm, organic, and transient illumination that requires manual maintenance and consumes physical matter to exist.
